source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: How many places does one million have?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many places does one million have?
stages.problemText: How many places does one million have?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. One million is 1 000 000. 2. It has 7 digits.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. One million is 1 000 000. 2. It has 7 digits.

stages.headline: Which digit is in the ten-thousands place of 86 413 705?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which digit is in the ten-thousands place of 86 413 705?
stages.problemText: Which digit is in the ten-thousands place of 86 413 705?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. The thousands class is 413. 2. Hundred-thousands 4, ten-thousands 1, thousands 3. 3. Answer: 1.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. The thousands class is 413. 2. Hundred-thousands 4, ten-thousands 1, thousands 3. 3. Answer: 1.

stages.headline: How many times greater is 10 000 than 100?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many times greater is 10 000 than 100?
stages.problemText: How many times greater is 10 000 than 100?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. From 100 to 10 000 we multiply by 10 twice. 2. 10 · 10 = 100 times.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. From 100 to 10 000 we multiply by 10 twice. 2. 10 · 10 = 100 times.

stages.headline: How many classes does 5 000 000 000 have?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Billions, millions, thousands, units. 2. Four classes.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Billions, millions, thousands, units. 2. Four classes.

stages.headline: How many millions make one billion?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many millions make one billion?
stages.problemText: How many millions make one billion?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. One billion is 1 000 000 000. 2. Dropping the units and thousands classes leaves 1 000 millions.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. One billion is 1 000 000 000. 2. Dropping the units and thousands classes leaves 1 000 millions.
